title: Grok Plugin Marketplace Component Catalog
description: CI-generated `plugin-index.json` component catalog. Directory precedence mirrors the marketplace index: `.grok-plugin/plugin-index.json` (preferred), then `.claude-plugin/plugin-index.json` — only one filename is probed per directory, and a present-but-broken preferred catalog does not fall back to the other directory. Presentation-layer enrichment only: a missing/malformed/unsupported-version catalog degrades to `None` and never fails a marketplace listing.. Deserialized into `PluginCatalog`.

version.description: Catalog format version. `PluginCatalog.version: u64` deserializes any integer, but `load_catalog` discards the entire catalog (falls back to `None`) unless it equals `SUPPORTED_VERSION = 1` — the current single supported version, enforced by application logic outside `Deserialize`. Required field on `PluginCatalog`.

plugins.description: Catalog entries keyed by index plugin name. `#[serde(default)] HashMap<String, CatalogEntry>` — absent key deserializes to an empty map.

sha.description: Commit the components were extracted from. Required for URL-sourced entries (gates `components_for` lookups against the pinned index SHA); optional for in-repo plugins. `#[serde(default)] Option<String>`.

components.description: Component inventory for this plugin. Required field on `CatalogEntry` (no `#[serde(default)]`).

componentItem.description: One concrete thing a plugin provides (a skill, command, agent, etc.). `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`.

name.description: Component name. Required field on `ComponentItem`; sanitized (control chars stripped, truncated to 120 chars) on ingestion.

description.description: Optional component description. `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] Option<String>`; for the `hooks` category this holds the optional matcher.

pluginComponents.description: Full inventory of a plugin's components, sourced from a marketplace catalog. `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`; every field is `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")] Vec<ComponentItem>`, so all six categories are optional and default to empty.

mcpServers.description: MCP server components. Rust field `mcp_servers` renamed to `mcpServers` by `rename_all = "camelCase"`.

hooks.description: Hook components. `name` = hook event (e.g. "PreToolUse"), `description` = optional matcher.

lspServers.description: LSP server components. Rust field `lsp_servers` renamed to `lspServers` by `rename_all = "camelCase"`.
